name: [NEW OBBY & UGC 🎁] Pancake Empire Tower Tycoon
desc:
Fidelity just dropped our biggest update yet: Waffle Stack Attack! Enter a whole new randomized obby full of adventure and new gameplay! Defend your Pancake Empire from the Waffle Boss as you race your friends to the top of the stack dodging marshmallows, molten maple syrup, and colleting our NEW currency, WamWams. Will you climb high for huge returns? Or will you get knocked into the syrupy pool of sweetness and lose all your earnings? There’s only one way to find out — play now!
